newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: VENTER LEISURE SHARES JUMP AGAIN ON TIP.
newsitem.headline: VENTER LEISURE SHARES JUMP AGAIN ON TIP.

text.p: Shares in South Africa's Venter Leisure and Commercial Trailers Ltd motored ahead for the second day running on Tuesday after a share tipster in the Sunday Tribune newspaper said they were worth a speculative punt.

The shares nearly doubled in price on Monday and at 1035 GMT on Tuesday were up nine cents, or 23.68 percent, to 47 cents -- a new year high and the biggest percentage gain on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
More than 200,000 shares had changed hands in morning trade.
"Venter was tipped in Tribune and everyone sort of just piled in after that," said one dealer.
Richard Cluver in his "Predictions" column said the shares were "another cheapie, which is just getting off the ground".

The share rise is a turn around for the group which in July ran foul of the JSE. The exchange said its listing was under threat after a failure to submit annual financial statement within six months of their financial year-end.
Venter is a holding group for three units engaged in making and selling trailers for commercial and leisure use.
